veranderings.voor: wat by hom ingaan die inset
veranderings.na: wat by hom ingaan, die inset
veranderings.rede: A comma closing the relative clause makes the sentence easier to read and matches 'Die deel wat ons wil hê, noem ons' in the next block.
'bly dood' is an odd way to describe a light that does not come on; 'bly donker' is the natural Afrikaans.

veranderings.voor: niks verander nie, en net die inset het verander
veranderings.na: niks verander nie. Net die inset het verander
veranderings.rede: The two halves contrast, and 'en' joins them weakly; two short sentences make the contrast clear.

veranderings.voor: Die energie lê al die tyd in daardie twee batterye gestoor
veranderings.na: Die energie is al die tyd in daardie twee batterye gestoor
veranderings.rede: 'lê ... gestoor' is wooden; the passive 'is ... gestoor' is the usual construction and keeps the meaning.

veranderings.voor: die ryer stoot self die pedale
veranderings.na: die ryer trap self die pedale
veranderings.rede: In Afrikaans you 'trap' a bicycle's pedals, not 'stoot' them; apply together with the next change so the noun matches.
Follows the verb change above: each push on a pedal is 'n trap'; only apply if the previous change is kept.

vlae.teks: By party huise maak die son op die dak die water warm.
vlae.rede: 'die son op die dak' reads literally as the sun sitting on the roof; the intended thing (sunlight on the roof, or a solar water heater on the roof) cannot be fixed without choosing the content, so the writer should decide.
